head: HeyGen Avatar 6: make an AI avatar video of yourself from a photo
dek: HeyGen launched Avatar 6, a model that turns one photo of you and a short recording of your voice into a video of you reading a script. It makes 2K video, matches hand gestures to what you say and can put two avatars in one conversation.
details: HeyGen says raters couldn't reliably tell its videos from real footage 84.4 percent of the time, its own test. The first video is free without a card; after that HeyGen uses credits, with paid plans from 29 dollars a month for 600 credits. You can only make an avatar of yourself or of someone who clearly agreed, and you can ask HeyGen to remove your likeness.
where: HeyGen website and app, worldwide, free first video
means: If you make videos and don't want to film yourself every time, you can type a script and get a clip with your own face and voice.
todo: To try it, upload a clear photo of your face, verify it's you, record at least 15 to 30 seconds of yourself talking, then add a script.
thumb_words: HEYGEN AVATAR 6: YOU FROM ONE PHOTO
